proxy.kind: ridge regression over elemental fractions, squared fractions, composition descriptors and processing indicators
proxy.alpha_selection: minimum equal-study-weight leave-one-DOI-out RMSE on historical proxy records only; ties choose the smaller alpha
proxy.study_weighting: each DOI has equal total regression weight

contract.target_selection_rule: all DOI studies from 2018 onward with at least four unique room-temperature recipes, reported processing, at least four elements, and no element absent from the historical vocabulary
contract.world_split_rule: sort normalized citation identifiers by SHA-256('doi:' + lowercase DOI); assign the first eight development and the remaining five heldout

limitations: The source is a retrospective literature compilation, not a prospective campaign.
The benchmark rules were developed after inspecting the public compilation and were not prospectively preregistered.
DOI grouping prevents row leakage but does not harmonize processing, microstructure or indentation protocol.
Only six of sixty-five target recipes have any exact composition/process record from another DOI; absence is not failed replication.
Exact composition/process matches are still not controlled experimental replicates and can differ by hundreds of HV.
Public finite worlds cannot rule out memorization or pretraining contamination.
